detail: The repo's own config.yml lists recency 0.3 / relevance 0.4 / decision_confidence 0.2 / warning_boost 0.1 (sum 1.0, no graph_reachability). git history shows these were written in commit 5cb0049 (2026-02-18) before graph_reachability existed (4846d70, 2026-03-13). Since v1.9.0 the deep-merge added the 0.35 default, sum hit 1.35, and loadConfig discarded all user weights — so assemble has actually run on full defaults for ~4 months. Under the new rule-1 semantics the four-key set would mean graph_reachability: 0, which was never the intent. Fix: make the file explicit with all five default values (0.2/0.2/0.15/0.1/0.35) — preserves actual live behavior and silences the warning.
summary: .twining/config.yml four-key priority_weights predate graph_reachability (written 2026-02-18, graph signal added 2026-03-13) — effective weights have been full defaults since v1.9.0 due to bug #34
